content: Řeḥṣaret d ufekki d tɣuyyit n wecḍan n Urcalim
Řḥukm issaggʷaden n wawař n SIDI x Israil. SIDI issawař, Netta d wenni ittbezzaɛen ajenna u issrusa dsas n temmurt u issbedda arruḥ n bnadem di daxeř nnes:
“Xzarem, Necc ad ggeɣ Urcalim d ṭṭebṣi n udewwex i marra řegnus i d as dd-innḍen uca ad dd-yas ṭṭebṣi nni uřa x Yahuda ɣar řeḥṣaret n Urcalim.

Deg wass nni ad imsar aqa Necc ad arreɣ Urcalim d ijj n weẓru ideqřen i marra řegnus. Marra inni yarezzun ad t ssgeɛɛden, ad ssyezmen ixef nsen aṭṭas u marra řegnus n ddunect ad ttwassmunen ḍidd nnes.
Deg wass nni, iqqar SIDI, ad wteɣ marra iysan s arjef d imnayen nnes s tubbuheřya, maca ad qqimeɣ arezzmeɣ tiṭṭawin inu x taddart n Yahuda, xmi i ɣa wteɣ marra iysan n řegnus s tuddarɣeč.
Imgewwaden n Yahuda ad inin deg wuř nsen: ‘Imezdaɣ n Urcalim ad iřin d jjehd inu s ufus n SIDI n řɛeskarat, AREBBI nsen!’

Deg wass nni ad ggeɣ imgewwaden n Yahuda am yijj n řmejmar n tmessi di taffa n ukeccuḍ u am yijj n weṣfeḍ jar tiqebbiḍin n imendi u nitni ad ffzen marra řegnus i d asen dd-innḍen, ɣar yefus u ɣar uzeřmaḍ, uca Urcalim ad teqqim ɛad deg wemcan nnes, di Urcalim.
SIDI ad issenjem amezwar iqiḍan n Yahuda ḥima ccan n taddart n Dawud d ccan n imezdaɣ n Urcalim war iddikkwiř d ameqqran aṭṭas qibač i Yahuda.
Deg wass nni ad issduriy SIDI imezdaɣ n Urcalim. Deg wass nni ad yiři wenni i ɣa innqarḍen jar asen am Dawud uca taddart n Dawud ad tiři am AREBBI, am lmalak n SIDI zzat i wudem nsen.
Deg wass nni ad imsar, aqa Necc ad rekkzeɣ ad mḥiɣ marra řegnus i dd ɣa yasen i řeḥṣaret ɣar Urcalim.

Maca ad farrɣeɣ Arruḥ n arḍa d tẓaǧitin x taddart n Dawud u x imezdaɣ n Urcalim u nitni ad ɣari dd-xzaren wenni di ssnuqqben. Nitni ad xas wten ayejdur am wtin agejdur x uyenni n mmis u ad xas ceḍnen s terzugi am wenni ittecḍinen x řmewt n mmis amenzu.
Deg wass nni ad tiři tɣuyyit n wecḍan temɣar di Urcalim, am tɣuyyit n wecḍan n Hadad-Rimmun di teɣzurt n Majiddun.
Tammurt ad tesɣuy zeg wecḍan, kuř řaǧ weḥḥdes. Řaǧ n taddart n Dawud weḥḥdes d temɣarin nsen weḥḥedsent, řaǧ n taddart n Natan weḥḥdes d temɣarin nsen weḥḥedsent.
Řaǧ n taddart n Lawi weḥḥdes d temɣarin nsen weḥḥedsent, řaǧ n Cimɛi weḥḥdes d temɣarin nsen weḥḥedsent.
Marra řaǧat nneɣni, kuř řaǧ weḥḥdes uřa d timɣarin weḥḥedsent.”
